title: Ransom Negotiations for Honour 25, Sward, MT Eureka Reach 'Advanced Stage' — Still Unresolved
detail: Ransom negotiations for the 44 crew held aboard Honour 25, Eureka and Sward reached an 'advanced stage,' involving flag states, shipowners and insurers, according to PTI reporting. Payments require vetting against UN, US, UK and EU sanctions lists before disbursement, to avoid running afoul of sanctions law. ReCAAP ISC executive director Vijay D. Chafekar commented on the process, but no payment or release has been confirmed as of this report — all three vessels remain hijacked more than two months after the crisis began.

title: Somalia and China Sign Duty-Free Fishery Export Agreement
detail: Somalia and China signed a duty-free fishery export agreement in Mogadishu — the first time Somali fishery products gained officially tariff-free access to the Chinese market — signed by Somalia's Minister of Fisheries and Blue Economy Ahmed Hassan Aden and Chinese Ambassador Wang Yu. The deal is part of China's broader zero-tariff policy for 53 African countries, removing tariffs of 8-30% on qualifying imports. Somali officials described it as a step toward diversifying the economy beyond aid dependency, amid the country's deepening humanitarian funding crisis.
